parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/MusicShareKit/Tests/MusicShareKitTests/RequestLineAuthFeatureTests.swift. Although the two test methods returnsFalseWhenFlagDisabled (line 25) and returnsFalseWhenFlagNotSet (line 55) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.889), they are distinct test cases exercising different flag conditions — one for a disabled flag and one for an absent flag — and their near-duplication is intentional fixture patterning. Merging or abstracting them would obscure the specific scenario each test documents and couples test semantics in a way that reduces diagnostic clarity on failure.
